EASTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
1A - PG 7528 - 04 (02/2026) This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
Notices issued by the Governor of Eastern Province

BY virtue of powers vested in me, under the Article 154C of the Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka I, Dr. Jayantha Lal Ratnasekera, Governor of Eastern Province, do hereby notify by this Notice amend the Schedule II of Notice published by the Governor of the Eastern Province in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2386/13 of May 30, 2024 on the subjects of the Ministries and Cluster of Eastern Provincial Council, by repeal of the Serial No. 04 and 06 of Schedule II thereto and the substitution thereof the following Schedule with effect from 2026.01.01.
Dr. Jayantha Lal Ratnasekera, Governor of Eastern Province.
Governor's Secretariat of Eastern Province,Orr's Hill,Trincomalee,18th February, 2026.
